title: I Miss Writing Code
why_read: Another reflective personal essay about losing the hands-on coding experience to AI-driven development workflows, emotionally resonant but not technical.
analysis: This piece is a short, personal reflection on how the author's day-to-day work has shifted from actually writing code to reviewing and directing AI-generated code, and the sense of loss that comes with that shift. It doesn't present new technical information, research, or tools, but captures a broader anxiety among engineers about role changes driven by AI coding assistants. This kind of content has emotional resonance for many developers but offers limited practical or technical substance for a digest focused on genuine technical interest. It reads more like an op-ed than an engineering piece.
